name: Singularity theory (Whitney, Thom, Mather, Arnold)
summary: Stable singularities of smooth maps are classified by algebra and topology, then applied to caustics, wavefronts and bifurcations.

name: K-theory and Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch: algebraic geometry enters topology
summary: A construction made for a Riemann-Roch theorem in algebraic geometry (a Grothendieck group of bundles) is imported into topology as a generalised cohomology theory.

name: Exotic spheres: algebraic topology reaches differential structures
summary: Characteristic classes and homotopy groups are used to show manifolds homeomorphic to the 7-sphere can be non-diffeomorphic, then to classify homotopy spheres.

name: Buildings: geometry of algebraic groups
summary: Simplicial complexes attached to groups of Lie type encode their parabolic subgroups, giving a geometric language for finite simple groups and p-adic groups.

name: Pontryagin maximum principle
summary: Necessary conditions for optimal control extended variational calculus.

name: Serre GAGA
summary: Analytic and algebraic coherent sheaf cohomology on projective varieties were shown to agree.

name: Control theory becomes a mathematical discipline (Kalman state space; ICM 1966 section)
summary: State-space methods, optimal control and filtering turn engineering control into a mathematical subject, and the 1966 Moscow congress lists a section on control theory.

name: Bott periodicity: Morse theory on loop spaces computes homotopy of Lie groups
summary: Morse theory applied to spaces of geodesics on loop spaces gives the periodicity of the stable homotopy groups of classical groups.

name: Selberg trace formula links spectra of surfaces to number theory
from: spectral theory / harmonic analysis on symmetric spaces
summary: A formula equates sums over Laplace eigenvalues with sums over closed geodesics, mirroring the explicit formulas of prime number theory and later generalised by Arthur.

name: Constructive quantum field theory
summary: Quantum fields in low dimensions are built rigorously from Markov random fields and reflection-positivity.
